# Cue v1.0.2

本版本修复当天任务的默认截止时间，改善 Linux 与 NAS 上的数据库备份部署，并完善 Dev 预发布和内测构建流程。

## 本版内容

- 桌面与移动端创建当天到期的任务时，默认截止时间统一为 23:59，避免在晚间新建任务后立即显示逾期；其他日期仍默认使用 18:00。
- 数据库备份容器支持通过 `.env` 中的 `CUE_UID`、`CUE_GID` 指定数字用户和组 ID，默认保持 `999:999`，便于 Linux、Synology DSM 和 Unraid 部署。
- 备份服务启动前自动预检备份目录及已有轮转子目录的读写、删除、硬链接和符号链接能力；失败时输出路径、UID/GID 和原因，并阻止备份容器启动，减少权限错误引起的重复告警。
- 补充备份目录权限、DSM ACL、定点修复和恢复验证说明；保留原有备份路径、备份周期、保留策略及数据库卷。配置 UID/GID 不会自动修改宿主机目录权限，升级时不要使用 `docker compose down -v`。
- Dev 预发布改为手动运行，并支持按平台进行内测构建和可选的内测 Docker 镜像推送；正式版与 Dev 共用递增构建编号。
- 发布附件提供固定 API/Web 镜像摘要的部署文件、源码与构建信息和校验文件；改进构建缓存、macOS 构建验证及发布文件校验。

## 获取与部署

| 平台 | 获取方式 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | `Cue-v1.0.2-macos-universal.dmg`（已公证，Apple Silicon 与 Intel 通用） |
| Windows | `Cue-v1.0.2-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Android | `Cue-v1.0.2-android-universal.apk` |
| Web 与 API | `docker-compose.yml` 与 `example.env`；镜像为 `ghcr.io/lz00qs/cue/cue-web:1.0.2` 和 `ghcr.io/lz00qs/cue/cue-api:1.0.2` |
| iOS | 由开发者另行通过 App Store 交付 |

Cue 需要自行部署服务端。按 [中文部署说明](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/blob/v1.0.2/README.zh.md)或 [English setup guide](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/blob/v1.0.2/README.md)配置服务端后，再连接客户端。首次部署时将 `example.env` 复制为 `.env`，与 `docker-compose.yml` 放在同一目录；已有部署保留原 `.env`。启用 HTTPS 配置时，还需从本版本源码取得 `docker/https.conf`。

升级前确认备份可恢复，保留备份和数据库卷，再按部署文档更新配置。备份身份未配置时使用 `999:999`；自定义身份后，应先运行 `docker compose run --rm --no-deps backup-permissions-check`，通过后再启动备份服务。使用支持 `service_completed_successfully` 的 Docker Compose 插件。备份目录必须支持 POSIX 硬链接和符号链接；DSM ACL 也可能影响访问权限。

[完整变更](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2)

## English

- Default tasks due today to 23:59 on desktop and mobile; tasks due on other dates still default to 18:00.
- Configure the backup container's numeric user and group IDs through `CUE_UID` and `CUE_GID`, retaining `999:999` as the default.
- Automatically check backup directory access, file creation/deletion, hard links, and symbolic links before starting the backup service. Report failures with the path and container identity, including checks of existing rotation directories.
- Document Linux and NAS permissions, DSM ACLs, targeted repairs, and restore verification. Keep the existing backup path, schedule, retention, and PostgreSQL volume. Setting IDs does not change host permissions; never use `docker compose down -v` for an upgrade.
- Make Dev prereleases manual and support platform-specific internal builds with optional internal Docker image pushes; share increasing build numbers across Stable and Dev.
- Include digest-pinned deployment files, source/build metadata, and checksums; improve build caching, macOS build validation, and release asset verification.

Deploy your own Cue server before connecting clients. Follow the [English setup guide](https://github.com/lz00qs/cue/blob/v1.0.2/README.md), and retain your existing `.env` when upgrading. Verify a restorable backup, configure the backup IDs if needed, and run the permission check before starting backups. Use a Docker Compose plugin supporting `service_completed_successfully` and backup storage supporting POSIX hard links and symbolic links. API and Web images use the `1.0.2` tag; deployment attachments pin their image digests. iOS is delivered separately through the App Store.
